    HOW IT WORKS

    Selected with care.
    Inspected before dispatch.

    From the manufacturer to our warehouse, then to you. Failed inspections hold dispatch until resolved.

    1. 01

      Choose your product

      Browse considered designs and read the specifications, supplier sources and outstanding checks.

    2. 02

      Confirm your total

      Your inclusive AUD price includes the manufacturer product price, a 10% service fee and all agreed costs.

    3. 03

      We inspect your order

      The manufacturer ships to our warehouse first. We check the agreed product and packaging, record the result and dispatch only after a pass.

    4. 04

      Receive and review

      Track onward delivery, contact FI if something is wrong and share an honest product review after your paid order is delivered.

    OUR CONDITION PROMISE

    Only orders that pass inspection proceed to dispatch. If your product arrives damaged or defective, FI helps arrange the appropriate remedy. Your consumer rights remain protected.

    COMING LATER

    Windows and glass

    Our sourcing focus includes China, Thailand, India and beyond. Windows and glass need further product and suitability checks before joining the collection.
